Preflight Demo Program
DOC-0001 2026-08-11
Intake Triage With a Written Priority Reason
POLICY
Effective date: 2026-08-11
Custodian: PERSON-0025, TEAM-0001
Scope: New issue intake and queue triage.
~ Use two-touch intake. The intake clerk first records the sender's question
and supplied reference. The receiving coordinator then checks the
destination and expected reply date. Include the subsystem label and the
team proposed to own the issue so that intake ends with a usable
coordination entry.
Set priority at intake with a written reason. Follow reason-before-rank:
describe the scheduling concern and consequence of delay before selecting
low, medium, or high. Put the reason above the priority box. A copied
subject heading is not a reason, and a crowded desk is not evidence about an
individual issue.
Record an owning team before passing the entry to the queue clerk. Ifa
person has not been selected, ask that team's shift lead to arrange the person
assignment; do not substitute the intake clerk merely because that clerk
prepared the sheet.
Put intake disagreements on an amber query card. The triage chair assigns
the question an addressee and a response date before the intake session
ends. Keep the original submission attached so the next reader can
distinguish the sender's account from the chair's decision.
Use ISSUE-0084 and DEMO-AIR-0009 as locating references when teaching
the electrical intake layout. Their inclusion supplies no priority assessment.
Revision note: This edition adds the reason-above-priority layout and the
amber query card to the intake checklist.
D. Worker 0025
Demo Worker 0025, Demo Team 01
